fix: Read-only monitoring (Block 24a): a collector polls every instance every 15 s with the unauthenticated CoD4x getstatus query (no RCON password) and records state, map, players and latency in daily JSONL files (30 days). A server that stops answering is declared down after 45 s (a map change takes 20-40 s), a crash at once; the outage carries the probable cause from the end of qconsole.log (ported from cod4-monitor, AGPL-3.0). Monitoring tab with history 24h/7d/30d, availability and outage list; new role monitor with monitor.read only; host CPU, RAM and free disk.
notes: 4.18.15 source preflight with the Monitoring gate (scripts/verify-4.18.15-monitor-gate.mjs). Remote access (gateway, PWA, cookie session, TOTP) follows in 24b, alerts in 24c. Development source, not a release or installer certification. No live deployment.
architecture: Shared Runtime with Windows and Linux adapters; schema-based Config Engine; per-instance RCON, master status, master list verification, plugin manager and B3 runtime; per-instance network exposure; eBc-B3 dependency layer
